name: SolitiCE
summary: Klondike solitaire, with scoring and a clock.
description:
Klondike solitaire for the TI-84 Plus CE. Version 2 was rewritten in C and added scoring, pictograms, custom card backs and a clock.

Arrows move the cursor, [2nd] picks a card up and puts it down, [alpha] moves a card wherever it will go, and [clear] quits.

The game saves itself when you close it, so quitting mid-hand loses nothing.
author: BasicTH

uninstall.text: SolitiCE saves your hand to an appvar it creates itself, which has been left alone — reinstalling picks the game back up. If you would rather clear it, look for a SolitiCE appvar under [2nd] [+], 2:Mem Mgmt/Del, AppVars.
